_comment: project -> the git repo its docs corpus is read from.
A `review` block turns the WRITE path on for that project. Without one the
corpus is read-only, which is the default. `type` is github today; `api`
defaults to https://api.github.com (set it for GitHub Enterprise);
`baseBranch` defaults to `branch`, so proposals cannot target something
Writes go out under the CALLER's own credential for that host, enrolled in
the credential store as backend `docs-github`, and need the `docs_writer`
or `docs_reviewer` role. Nothing here can merge a proposal -- see ADR-0017
for what your repository's own settings still have to carry.
